Suction device multipick detection and Suction device and apparatus address suction cup based picking with grasp attempt and multipick sensing. Finger assembly and method describes a linked finger structure for grasping items. Together these efforts target suction based and fingered robotic picking systems.

overview_description.description:
RightHand Robotics provides end-to-end solutions that reduce the cost of e-commerce order-fulfillment of electronics, apparel, grocery. Their robots grasp a wide variety of items from bins and cases. Their core technology enables them to do this automatically without laborious data entry or parameter-tuning — so they are inexpensive to set up and flexible to the changing needs of businesses.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts.

product.name: RightPick™ System
product.description: An autonomous robotic piece-picking solution that uses AI and proprietary hardware to pick and place thousands of SKUs without prior training.

product.name: RightPick™ Fleet Management
product.description: A control center providing real-time visibility, remote operation, and data analytics for managing a fleet of RightPick robots.

product.name: RightCare™ Support Service
product.description: A customer support service offering 24/7 assistance, preventative maintenance, and software updates for RightPick systems.

product.name: RightPick™ Barcode Scanning Add-On
product.description: An optional feature that enables the RightPick system to scan barcodes on items during the picking process for traceability and order validation.

product.name: RightPick™ Suction Cup Swapper
product.description: A hardware add-on that allows the RightPick robot to switch suction cup types in real time to handle a wider variety of products.
